blocks.t: JOHNNY NERO ACTION HERO TECHNICAL BULLETIN

Please be advised that the Action Hero Main logic PCB is sensitive to the 5 Volt in-put it receives from the power supply. It is recommended that the 5 Volt line is properly adjusted to 5.0V+t+or-.1V.
A SV input that is too high or low may prohibit the game from booting-up or could cause the game to re-set. Please properly adjust the 5V before installing the main logic board.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.
Thank you for supporting I.C.E. products.
